other_failure_modes.name: Test feature distribution leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Calculating aggregate feature statistics (such as frequency encodings, group means, or group standard deviations) on the combined train and test sets before splitting. This leaks the distribution of the test set features into the training data.

summary: The agent implements a structurally strong pipeline with K-Fold cross-validation, proper out-of-fold target encoding, and optimized blending. However, it introduces significant data leakage by applying TF-IDF, SVD, frequency encodings, and group aggregations on the combined train and test sets prior to splitting. Furthermore, it ignores the temporal nature of the financial data by using a random split, risking look-ahead bias, and relies solely on RMSE without addressing the likely skewness of the target variable.
